Resolves #5574

Adds a top-level `API Docs` entry (`id: 'ApiDocs'`, `route: '/docs'`) to `learn/tree.json` and `[API Docs](#/docs)` under `## Documentation Sections` in `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`, extends `Portal.model.Content` with a `route` field, and updates `Neo.app.content.TreeList#onLeafItemClick` and `Portal.view.learn.MainContainerController` (`navigateTo`, `onRouteLearnItem`, `onRouteDefault`) to route `record.route` entries to `/docs` while keeping tree selection synced to `currentPageRecord` (Contract Ledger: [`IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABi0p3Bw`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/5574#issuecomment-6631880455)).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline lint-staged + unit tests + check-relative-links ran` (`--change-class capability`).

Evidence: L1 (`npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/app/content/TreeList.spec.mjs` — `6 passed` covering `learn/tree.json`, `TreeList#onLeafItemClick`, and `Portal.view.learn.MainContainerController`) → L1 required.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

KB ingestion and the SEO routes skip `ApiDocs`, because `learn/ApiDocs.md` doesn't exist. Two places differ from my expected shape: the redirect's history semantics (note 1), and the controller arm's spec placement (note 3).

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge** (four, all non-blocking):
  1. **The deep-link redirect traps Back. Inferred from code, not run.** `onRouteLearnItem` redirects `#/learn/ApiDocs` through `Neo.Main.setRoute`, which assigns `location.hash` and so pushes a new entry. Back from `#/docs` returns to `#/learn/ApiDocs`, which redirects again. Today only a typed or shared URL reaches it: the tree click and `navigateTo` both route `record.route` directly. A history-neutral redirect would fix it, for example a `replace` option on `setRoute` that calls `location.replace`. That belongs in its own ticket, not this PR.
  2. **`[API Docs](#/docs)` is the corpus's first hash-route link.** No other `learn/*.md` uses `](#/…)`. It works in the Portal, is a dead in-page anchor for a GitHub reader, and `check-relative-links` waves it through as a bare anchor. That's fine for a Portal-first corpus, but it is a new convention. One line in the body would record that it was chosen on purpose.
  3. **Spec placement.** The `MainContainerController` arm sits in `test/playwright/unit/app/content/TreeList.spec.mjs`. That makes an engine-class spec import `apps/portal/store/Content.mjs` and `apps/portal/view/learn/MainContainerController.mjs`, while Portal learn routing already has `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/LearnRoutes.spec.mjs`. Moving that arm keeps the engine spec free of app imports.
  4. **An implicit field contract in an engine class.** `Neo.app.content.TreeList` now honours a record field named `route`, documented only in `onLeafItemClick`'s JSDoc. A class-level sentence ("a record's `route` overrides `routePrefix/id`") would make the contract discoverable for other content apps.
